bill_text.text_with_changes:
A bill for an act relating to housing; appropriating money for the family homeless prevention and assistance program.

BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF MINNESOTA:

Section 1. [+APPROPRIATION; FAMILY HOMELESS PREVENTION. +]

[+$....... in fiscal year 2026 and $....... in fiscal year 2027 are appropriated from the general fund to the commissioner of the Housing Finance Agency for the family homeless prevention and assistance program under Minnesota Statutes, section 462A.204. +]
